checks.title: No bare or broad except hides a failure the caller needs
falsifiers: the exception is logged and re-raised
the swallowed case is documented and intended
validation_methods: trace the except to its caller
an approved test that raises inside the try
checks.limits: BaseException, KeyboardInterrupt and SystemExit swallowing is in scope.

checks.title: Async code survives cancellation and timeouts without leaking
validation_methods: an approved test that cancels the task
checks.limits: Fire-and-forget tasks without a reference are candidates.

checks.title: Subprocess calls are bounded, checked and not shell-injectable
falsifiers: check=True or the return code is handled
checks.limits: Shell injection judgments belong to the security workflow; record the data flow.

checks.title: No mutable default arguments or module state shared by accident
evidence_required: two callers that observe each other's changes
checks.limits: Report the observable effect, not the pattern.

checks.title: Integer/float conversion, rounding and division match the contract
evidence_required: the contract for the result (units, rounding rule)
validation_methods: an approved test with a boundary value
checks.limits: int() truncates toward zero; round() is banker's rounding.

checks.title: ORM and DB-API work commits or rolls back as one unit
falsifiers: a session scope wraps the unit
validation_methods: an approved test that fails midway
